description: Eskom direct supply tariffs — applies where Eskom (not a municipality) is the licensed electricity distributor
notes: From 1 July 2025 Eskom migrated from Megaflex/Miniflex to Municflex for bulk municipal supply. This restructuring means new tariff names and unbundled charges. Key change: GCC (Generation Capacity Charge) now separate from energy c/kWh.
structural_change_2025_26: Megaflex/Miniflex discontinued. All local authorities now on Municflex. New: separate legacy c/kWh + R/kVA Generation Capacity Charge (GCC). Municipalities must pass this through to end consumers.

homelight_homepower_changes.notes: NERSA approved removal of IBTs for Eskom Homelight/Homepower. All Eskom residential direct customers now pay flat rate. Fixed charges on Homepower 4 and Homeflex 4 increased ~88%.

confidence_overall: CONFIRMED from NERSA approval and Eskom tariff booklet
